text_block_list.text: Now that is a path worthy of being conquered by the "Supreme Overlord"—the Path of Supremacy!

My majesty that will never yield to any adversity...!"

What, truly, is strength?

No matter how many times you stumble, you never stop your legs.

To conquer this "path of supremacy"...!
